description: Use this when the user wants the details of one job found with search_jobs: pay, location, job type, and the employer description. Takes the job slug or the full job URL. Returns facts, the employer-written text, and the link to read the full listing and apply. Not for searching. A job that closed returns a message saying so.

job.description: Job slug from search_jobs, or the full nextgenenergyjobs.com job URL.

name: get_job
